3/7 5/16
Shanghai Municipal Council.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)
May 31st 1916.

Sir,
The Asiatic Daily News has removed its offices from
Noll Shantung Road to No.13 Burkill Road.
It is reported that the rebel government of
Chekiang has sent a monetary present to the family of
Chen Chi Me. It is also said that a memorial service
will be held in Chen's honour in Hangchow on 4th proximo.
Tsu Tuh Eu 周德雪 left for Chekiang with one
hundred and twenty men on 30th inst. Tsu is one of
Nysu Tih Sung's staff officers.
Fearing that something may occur as a result
of the rumours regarding Yuan's death, precautionary
measures were taken in the Arsenal yesterday.
It is reported that General Yang has been
offered the position of Chiangchun of Kiangsi, but
he has refused it.

Your Obedient Servant,
muiunauutroy
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

OH
Endorsed
pages.zh:
362
3/7 5/16
上海工部局。
（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股。）
1916年5月31日。

先生：
《亚细亚日报》社已将其办事处从山东路诺尔（Noll Shantung Road）迁至伯基尔路13号。
据报，浙江叛乱政府已向陈其美家属赠送礼金。另悉，将于下月4日在杭州举行纪念陈其美的追悼会。
周德雪于本月30日率领一百二十人前往浙江。周系倪嗣冲的参谋人员之一。
因担心有关袁世凯死讯的谣言可能引发事端，昨日兵工厂已采取预防措施。
据报，杨将军已被授以江西督军之职，但其已予拒绝。

您顺从的仆人，
muiunauutroy
总探长。

警务处总监。

OH
